description: This file defines the signup page component and related server-side logic for user registration, using Remix framework with React. It includes loader and action functions for data fetching and form handling, and renders a signup form with validation and error handling.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loader function that checks if a user is already authenticated and redirects to /notes if so; otherwise returns an empty JSON response.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Action function that processes the signup form data, sends a signup request to the API, handles errors, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: Signup
methods.description: React component rendering the signup form, handling user input, validation states, and displaying errors.
